_comment: Add the SuperCarl MCP to OpenClaw. Merge into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json, set your SuperCarl key, restart the gateway. toolFilter.include restricts OpenClaw to SuperCarl's search/read tools (no outreach, no account changes). agent_session is included so SuperCarl can identify the calling agent as OpenClaw (client_name/client_version) rather than the underlying model harness.
